description: This file contains C# attribute classes, interfaces, enums, and metadata annotations for the Orleans serialization abstractions, including attribute definitions for code generation, serialization, and invocation behaviors.

classes.name: AliasAttribute
classes.description: Attribute for defining an alias name for types or members in serialization.

classes.name: ApplicationPartAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the assembly name as part of application parts.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasAttribute
classes.description: Attribute for defining composite type aliases.

classes.name: DefaultInvokableBaseTypeAttribute
classes.description: Specifies the default invokable base type for a class.

classes.name: DefaultInvokeMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Specifies a default method name to invoke for serialization or invocation purposes.

classes.name: GenerateCodeForDeclaringAssemblyAttribute
classes.description: Indicates that code should be generated for a particular declaring assembly.

classes.name: GeneratedActivatorConstructorAttribute
classes.description: Attribute marking a constructor as generated for activation purposes.

classes.name: GenerateMethodSerializersAttribute
classes.description: Indicates that serializing methods should be generated for interfaces.

classes.name: GenerateSerializerAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating that a class or struct should have a serializer generated.

classes.name: GetCompletionSourceMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Specifies the method name to get a completion source.

classes.name: IConverter
classes.description: Interface for converting between a TValue and its surrogate.

classes.name: IdAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to assign an ID to types or members for serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class, struct, or enum as immutable.

classes.name: InvokableBaseTypeAttribute
classes.description: Specifies the base type for invokable classes.

classes.name: InvokableCustomInitializerAttribute
classes.description: Assigns a custom initializer method for invokable classes.

classes.name: InvokeMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Defines the method name to invoke.

classes.name: IPopulator
classes.description: Interface for populating an object from a surrogate.

classes.name: OmitDefaultMemberValuesAttribute
classes.description: Indicates default member values should be omitted during serialization.

classes.name: OrleansConstructorAttribute
classes.description: Marks a constructor for use with Orleans dependency injection.

classes.name: RegisterActivatorAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class as an activator for serialization purposes.

classes.name: RegisterConverterAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class as a converter for serialization.

classes.name: RegisterCopierAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class as a copier for serialization.

classes.name: RegisterProviderAttribute
classes.description: Declares a provider for a specific resource or feature.

classes.name: RegisterSerializerAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class or struct as a serializer.

classes.name: ResponseTimeoutAttribute
classes.description: Specifies a timeout for responses.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksAttribute
classes.description: Associates serialization callbacks with a hook type.

classes.name: SerializerTransparentAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class as serializer transparent.

classes.name: SuppressReferenceTrackingAttribute
classes.description: Suppresses reference tracking during serialization.

classes.name: UseActivatorAttribute
classes.description: Indicates that an activator should be used for instantiation.
